title: TM-Customer Service PR
description:
**Job Summary**
This role focuses on delivering high quality customer service solutions for transportation management clients using Node JS React and Angular JS within a hybrid work model and night shifts. The professional will design enhance and support digital customer experience platforms ensuring reliability scalability and strong integration with logistics systems while aligning outcomes to client and company goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design robust customer service applications using Node JS React and Angular JS that improve response times and enhance overall client satisfaction across transportation and logistics engagements.
* Develop secure scalable and reusable service components that support multi channel customer interactions including web interfaces support tools and internal operations workflows.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams in product support and operations to translate complex customer service requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.
* Coordinate with transportation management stakeholders to ensure that digital solutions align with industry regulations routing constraints and service level expectations.
* Implement integration solutions that connect customer service platforms with transportation management and logistics systems to provide real time shipment status and incident updates.
* Optimize application performance for night shift operations by fine tuning queries caching strategies and front end rendering to support high availability and reliability.
* Monitor production systems during night shifts to identify issues proactively and drive rapid resolution of defects incidents and performance bottlenecks.
* Document technical designs configuration details and support procedures in clear language to streamline future enhancements troubleshooting and knowledge transfer.
* Conduct thorough unit testing integration testing and regression testing of Node JS React and Angular JS components to maintain stable releases with minimal production defects.
* Coordinate with quality and support teams to define acceptance criteria for customer service features and to validate that delivered functionality meets user expectations.
* Implement best practices for security logging and error handling that protect customer data and ensure audit readiness across transportation and logistics applications.
* Assist in planning and executing releases for hybrid work teams by aligning development testing and deployment activities with night shift schedules and support windows.
* Mentor peers on efficient coding patterns within Node JS React and Angular JS stacks to encourage consistent implementation standards and maintainable codebases.

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive experience designing and developing applications using Node JS React and Angular JS with strong emphasis on modular architecture and maintainable code.
* Demonstrate proven ability to work in complex customer service environments supporting digital channels that operate in hybrid work models and across night shifts.
* Show hands on experience integrating applications with transportation management or logistics platforms to deliver real time tracking case handling and status visibility.
* Exhibit strong understanding of microservice patterns restful APIs and asynchronous processing to support high volume customer service workflows.
* Apply knowledge of secure coding practices performance tuning and fault tolerance techniques to maintain reliable systems for global transportation clients.
* Display familiarity with agile delivery methods issue tracking tools and continuous integration pipelines that support frequent and stable deployments.
* Value collaboration clear communication and inclusive behaviors that strengthen diverse teams and enhance overall customer service outcomes.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Node JS certification and any cloud platform developer certification such as Azure Developer Associate or AWS Developer Associate.

title: Foundational Internship - Technology & Intellectual Media
description:
About Arivula

Arivula Technologies LLP is an AI-native product company building innovative technology products from India. We believe curiosity, commitment and the ability to learn deeply matter more than existing qualifications.

Our Foundational Internship is a structured six-month program designed to develop capabilities, discover potential and build our future teams.

Your Internship Journey

The program progresses through three stages:

**1. Research, Learn & Communicate**

Explore unfamiliar concepts through first-principles thinking. Participate in research, technical storytelling, script development and AI-assisted conceptual animation.

**2. Explore Technology Through Challenges**

Work on practical technical challenges, experiment with different technologies, solve problems and discover your strengths.

**3. Choose Your Stream & Own Real Work**

Progress toward one of four career pathways:

* **Product Development:**
  Build modules for real software products.
* **Applied AI:**
  Develop intelligent applications, agents and workflows.
* **AI Model Development:**
  Explore and experiment with AI model development.
* **Intellectual Media:**
  Develop technical research, storytelling and conceptual animations for published content.

What We Offer

* Structured, personalized and technology-assisted mentorship.
* Opportunities to contribute to meaningful products and intellectual media.
* Necessary software, AI tools and technical resources.
* Flexible, outcome-oriented working arrangements.
* A pathway toward full-time employment based on demonstrated capability and dependability.

Internship Details

**Duration:**
6 months

**Stipend:**
Unpaid

**Commitment:**
Predominantly full-time, with flexible working hours and outcome-based expectations.

**Location:**
Chennai, with remote, office and hybrid arrangements available.

**Eligibility:**
No prior technical experience required. Final-semester students may receive special consideration.

Interns are expected to have their own laptops.

Full-Time Opportunities

There is no fixed hiring quota. Every intern who demonstrates exceptional performance and meets Arivula's dependability standards will be offered a suitable full-time role.

Qualifying full-time conversions receive a joining bonus of
**₹1 lakh to ₹1.5 lakh**
.

How to Apply

If this opportunity interests you, please write to
**careers@arivula.com**
expressing your interest.

We will share a detailed overview of the internship, including the program structure, expectations and application process.

We encourage candidates to read through the overview carefully, ask questions and make an informed decision before applying.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
description:
**Description**

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at QBurst, you will occupy one of the most strategically important engineering roles within the organization. Working directly with high-value clients, you will embed within their engineering teams to design, build, and deliver impactful technology solutions. You will combine deep technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills to solve complex business challenges, accelerate delivery, and establish trusted client relationships.

Success in this role means rapidly understanding client needs, translating them into scalable technical solutions, delivering high-quality outcomes, and creating opportunities for long-term strategic partnerships through technical excellence and business impact.

**Responsibilities**

* Embed within client engineering teams and contribute directly to the design, development, deployment, and support of production-grade applications and AI-powered solutions
* Drive end-to-end software delivery, from requirements gathering and solution design to implementation, testing, deployment, and post-production support
* Operate as a senior engineering resource within client environments, ensuring high-quality and timely execution
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent platforms as an integral part of the software development lifecycle
* Develop and promote reusable prompt engineering practices, AI workflows, and productivity-enhancing development patterns
* Evaluate AI tools and provide recommendations on their effective usage, limitations, and validation requirements
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor by providing guidance on architecture, scalability, security, performance, and engineering best practices
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and lead technical design discussions and architecture reviews
* Establish and uphold coding standards, quality assurance practices, and engineering excellence across engagements
* Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, including engineering leaders, product teams, and executive sponsors
* Identify opportunities to expand client engagements by uncovering additional business needs and recommending value-driven solutions
* Support technical presentations, solution discussions, and strategic conversations that contribute to account growth
* Contribute reusable frameworks, accelerators, AI workflows, prompt libraries, and best practices to QBurst’s internal knowledge repository
* Mentor team members and promote the adoption of modern engineering and AI-enabled development practices
* Stay current with emerging technologies, AI advancements, and industry trends to continuously enhance delivery capabilities

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience delivering enterprise-grade applications in production environments
* Proven experience delivering at least two complete software development lifecycles, from solution design through deployment and ongoing support
* Demonstrated daily use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent platforms in a professional setting
* Proficiency in at least two programming languages, with expertise spanning backend, frontend, or data engineering technologies
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including deployment, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting
* Strong understanding of APIs, microservices architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development methodologies
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders
* Proven ability to manage client expectations, navigate critical incidents, and maintain stakeholder trust in demanding environments
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to balance technical excellence and business outcomes
* Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or in a client-facing engineering role is preferred
* Experience building AI agents and workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies is desirable
* Professional certifications such as AWS Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, TOGAF, or AI/ML specialty certifications are a plus
* Exposure to pre-sales activities, including solution discovery, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations, is advantageous

title: Technical Lead, Software Development
description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The ICOS Vision Systems division focuses on the backend of the line semiconductor industry providing fully automated tools to inspect and sort, finished integrated circuit packages. For more than 15 years, ICOS has been a market leader with tray-to-tray and tray-to-tape inspection and sorting tools found in the production facilities of all major chipmakers in the world. Our market-leading technology and superior customer service requires strong talent in optics, machine control, algorithms and applications within our engineering teams. The ICOS division headquarters are in Leuven, Belgium with additional engineering and manufacturing operations in Singapore and Shenzhen (China).
  
  
**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**

* As a software engineer in our component inspection development team, you will be part of an international Scrum team that uses agile standard methodologies to build stable and maintainable software.
* You will apply the latest techniques in C++ and C# software design to develop software that ranges from control of image acquisition and processing up till modern WPF user interfaces.
* You will have the opportunity to occasionally travel to customers and discover new places and cultures along the way.
* Team training sessions and access to online learning portals will ensure that your knowledge stays up-to-date and allow you to grow beyond your current know-how.
* From on the edge software development, designing advanced machines, defining and implementing image processing algorithms or crafting new ways to do optical inspections, we do it all, and we need your talent to keep going one step beyond!

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
* Minimum an MS degree in engineering with at least 5 years of experience.
* Extensive programming skills in modern C++.
* Knowledge of object-oriented design, design patterns, and UML.
* An affinity to vision applications is a plus.
* Knowledge of C#, WPF, Python, GIT and Scrum are a plus.
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently without guidance as an Individual contributor.
* Proficient in English

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

description:

**Android Developer**
with strong expertise in native Android development using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. The ideal candidate will contribute to ongoing product development initiatives, building high-quality, scalable, and performance-optimized mobile applications.
  
  
The project involves

with
**Compose Multiplatform**
for shared UI development. While the primary focus will be on Android, the candidate should also be capable of supporting a minimum viable iOS implementation to enable future cross-platform expansion.

* Build production-ready, responsive, and reusable user interfaces using Jetpack Compose.
* Develop and contribute to shared business logic and UI components using Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform.
* Support the development of a minimum viable iOS application using shared Kotlin Multiplatform components.

* Optimize application performance, memory usage, responsiveness, and overall user experience.
* Work with Compose state management, navigation, Material Design 3, coroutines, and Flow.
* Integrate native Android components and, where required, C/C++ libraries through JNI/JNA.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application and native component issues.
* Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, architects, QA engineers, and other development teams.
* Leverage Generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows to improve productivity and code quality.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, documentation, knowledge sharing, and mentoring activities.

**Required Technical Skills 1. Native Android Development**

* Strong hands-on experience in Kotlin and native Android application development.
* Good understanding of Android SDK, application lifecycle, threading, and memory management.
* Experience with Android architecture best practices, clean architecture, and design patterns.
* Proficiency in debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.

2. Jetpack Compose
  
  

* Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose in production applications.
* Strong understanding of declarative UI development and reusable UI components.
* Experience with Compose state management, Navigation Compose, and Material Design 3.
* Ability to develop responsive, maintainable, and high-performance user interfaces.

3. Kotlin Multiplatform & Compose Multiplatform
  
  

* Working knowledge or hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
* Understanding of sharing business logic and common code across Android and iOS.
* Familiarity with Compose Multiplatform for developing shared user interfaces.
* Ability to support a minimum working iOS application and understand platform-specific integrations.
* Familiarity with iOS project integration, Xcode, and Kotlin Multiplatform build workflows is an advantage.

**Experience Requirements**
**Senior-Level Consultant**

* 7 11 years of relevant Android/Kotlin development experience.
* Minimum 2 years of practical Jetpack Compose experience.
* Strong expertise in Android architecture, UI development, and performance optimization.
* Kotlin Multiplatform or Compose Multiplatform experience is preferred.

**Mid-Level Consultant**

* Minimum 4 years of relevant Android/Kotlin development experience.
* Minimum 2 years of practical Jetpack Compose experience.
* Strong fundamentals in Android development, modern UI implementation, and debugging.
* Familiarity with Kotlin Multiplatform and shared UI development is desirable.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced product development environment.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Proactive approach to learning, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.
* Ability to mentor team members and clearly communicate technical concepts.

title: Software Development Engineer - 3
description:
AssetPlus is redefining the future of wealth management. We're a fast-scaling SaaS fintech platform powering mutual fund distributors (MFDs) and financial advisors with tools that modernise how investments are managed. Our mission is to build India's best assisted wealth management platform, helping millions of households achieve their financial goals.
  
  
Engineering at AssetPlus is a growth led, high-velocity team of ~18 engineers organized into three product pods. We ship on a modern, AI-enabled Node.js + TypeScript + MongoDB stack, own our systems in production, and hold a high technical and cultural bar. If you want to solve meaningful problems at scale with real ownership, this is the place.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a deeply hands-on SDE-3 who owns features end-to-end and raises the quality bar within a pod. You bring strong technical judgment, speed, clarity and simplicity to everything you build. You will be a core builder inside one product pod: designing services, writing production Node.js + TypeScript, shaping MongoDB schemas, debugging across backend, React and Flutter, and keeping the systems you own reliable. You will use AI as a cognitive partner to move faster without lowering the bar.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Systems**

* Design and build scalable, resilient services within your pod's domain.
* Contribute to system design reviews and argue trade-offs with first-principles reasoning.
* Decide what to build vs reuse vs adopt open-source, and explain the call.
* Follow and strengthen the architecture patterns the team has agreed on.

**Hands-On Engineering**

* Write high-quality Node.js + TypeScript code - readable, tested, production-grade.
* Design efficient MongoDB schemas and build complex aggregations.
* Debug issues across React, Flutter and Backend, down to the infra and DB layer.
* Leverage AI capabilities and develop at a high pace with good taste.

**AI Driven Engineering**

* Use AI as a cognitive partner to accelerate coding, debugging, design and decision-making.
* Orchestrate models, tools, context and workflows into a productive AI-powered engineering loop.

What you will bring
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field with 3–6 years of mobile engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on iOS application development.
  
  
Expertise in developing iOS mobile apps using Swift and Objective-C, along with a strong understanding of mobile app design principles and user experience (UX) considerations.

Track record of ensuring performance, quality, and responsiveness of iOS applications across various Apple devices and OS versions.
  
  
Knowledge on REST APIs and GraphQL for backend integrations — including a solid understanding of general best practices, limitations, and trade-offs of each approach.
  
  
Experience with offline storage (Core Data, Realm, SwiftData), local caching, and asynchronous programming(async/await, Combine, GCD).
  
  
Familiarity with push notifications and cloud messaging APIs (APNs — Apple Push Notification service, Firebase Cloud Messaging).
  
  
Conducting thorough code reviews, maintaining code quality, and ensuring adherence to team coding standards and Apple platform conventions.
  
  
Experience with CI/CD pipelines for iOS — including tools such as Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Fastlane, and Xcode Cloud — for building, testing, and deploying applications.

Solid understanding of mobile security practices, performance optimization, and memory management in iOS environments (ARC, retain cycles, profiling with Instruments).

A continuous learner with strong problem-solving skills, keen attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset.

Apple platform depth — background execution, deep/universal links, extensions/widgets, app lifecycle, signing/provisioning, and entitlements.
  
  
Active participation in the full iOS development lifecycle — including sprint planning, feature development, testing, App Store submission, and production monitoring.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER
  
  
**Location: Chennai | Type: Fulltime**
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.
  
  
From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.
  
  
We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people s lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.
  
  
You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You Ll Do**
**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

**Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.

**Test, Deploy, Productionize**

* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline: hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they break and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:
  
  

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

**Ready to Apply?**
Let s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to:
  
  
*shubhi.tiwari@newpage.io*

title: Senior Product Designer - Mobile
description:
**Mobile Product Designer**

4 – 6 years · Full-time · iOS & Android ·
**Field-first**

**THE ROLE**

Zuper is a field service management platform built for the trades — and our customers' teams run on mobile. They're at job sites, in trucks, in attics, making decisions with a phone in one hand and a clipboard in the other. We're looking for a designer who can own that platform entirely: building experiences that work in real-world conditions, not ideal ones. Glare, gloves, interrupted connectivity, and two-second attention spans are the actual design brief.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own the end-to-end design of Zuper's mobile and tablet experiences across iOS and Android
* Design for the field — job sites, vehicles, client walkthroughs — where context shifts fast and the UI has to keep up
* Handle connectivity edge cases like a first-class design problem: offline states, sync flows, partial data, and graceful degradation
* Use native platform capabilities purposefully — camera for estimates and documentation, GPS for job context, push for timely handoffs
* Talk to our customers' teams regularly — understand their day in the field before you design for it
* Build and extend the mobile component library within the Prelude design system
* Prototype on real devices and test in real conditions — not just in Figma

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Mobile-native thinking**

* Strong knowledge of iOS and Android design conventions.
* Ability to decide when to follow platform patterns and when to deviate from them.
* Ability to justify design decisions.

**Context-aware design**

* Design for one-handed phone usage.
* Consider gloves, bright sunlight, and split attention.
* Adapt the design to real-world working environments.

**Connectivity & state design**

* Follow an offline-first design approach.
* Design loading, syncing, stale-data, and failure states.
* Ensure all application states are carefully considered, not just the ideal user journey.

**Speed & efficiency**

* Create fast and efficient user flows.
* Reduce the number of steps required to complete tasks.
* Simplify interactions to improve customer productivity.

**Tablet layouts**

* Design effective interfaces for tablet-sized screens.
* Use split views, side panels, and denser information layouts.
* Make deliberate use of tablet screen space instead of simply scaling up mobile layouts.

**Customer obsession**

* Regularly interact with customers through calls.
* Treat customers as active design partners.
* Use customer conversations as research opportunities.
* Understand customer needs and workflows before designing solutions.

**Ownership**

* Independently identify mobile platform requirements.
* Identify and resolve broken or inefficient user experiences.
* Take ownership of the mobile experience without waiting for detailed specifications.

**Experience**

* 4–6 years of product design experience.
* Strong, demonstrable mobile design portfolio.
* B2B or enterprise mobile product design experience is a strong advantage.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Field service or construction software
* React Native familiarity
* Mobile design system ownership
* Accessibility on mobile
* Trades industry experience
* Prototyping in code

**ABOUT ZUPER**

Zuper builds field service management software for the trades — roofing, HVAC, plumbing, and beyond. We're an AI-first team working on problems that actually matter to the businesses running on our platform. Our design team owns the full stack: from research and strategy to production-ready UI and the Prelude design system that runs under it all.

title: Robotic Engineer - Internship
description:
Internship Opportunity – Robotics Design & Development Engineer

**Company:**
AerX Space Labs

**Division:**
Robotics, Autonomous Systems & AI

**Position:**
Robotics Design & Development Intern

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Internship Duration:**
3–6 Months

**Eligibility:**
Engineering students, final-year students and recent graduates

**Internship Type:**
Full-time / Project-based

About AerX Space Labs

AerX Space Labs is focused on developing next-generation intelligent robotic and autonomous systems, including aerial drones, quadruped robotic dogs, autonomous ground robots and underwater robotic platforms.

We are looking for
**highly motivated, technically capable and hands-on robotics interns**
who can quickly contribute to the design, development, assembly, programming and testing of real-world robotic systems.

This opportunity is intended for students who have already built robotics projects and are passionate about transforming engineering concepts into functional prototypes.

Key Responsibilities
  
1. Robotics Design & Mechanical Development

* Design robotic structures, chassis, joints, mounting systems and mechanical assemblies.
* Develop 3D CAD models using SolidWorks, Fusion 360, CATIA or equivalent tools.
* Support mechanical design for quadruped robots, autonomous ground vehicles and robotic mechanisms.
* Select motors, actuators, gearboxes, bearings and mechanical components.
* Support 3D printing, fabrication, prototype assembly and mechanical testing.

2. Electronics & Embedded Systems

* Select and integrate microcontrollers, sensors, motor drivers and communication modules.
* Work with Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi or NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
* Integrate servo motors, BLDC motors, encoders, IMUs, LiDAR and cameras.
* Assist with power distribution, battery management and electronic troubleshooting.
* Develop and test embedded control systems.

3. Robotics Programming & Autonomous Navigation

* Develop robotic control software using Python and C/C++.
* Work with ROS/ROS 2 for robotic communication, control and navigation.
* Implement motion control, locomotion, obstacle avoidance and path planning.
* Support SLAM, sensor fusion and autonomous navigation.
* Integrate real-time sensor data with robotic control systems.

4. AI & Computer Vision Integration

* Integrate cameras and AI vision systems into robotic platforms.
* Support object detection, human detection, obstacle recognition and intelligent surveillance applications.
* Work with OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow or YOLO-based detection systems.
* Assist with deploying AI models on edge computing devices.
* Support integration with Mirador AI for intelligent perimeter surveillance and automated alerts.

5. Prototype Assembly & Testing

* Assemble complete robotic prototypes from mechanical and electronic components.
* Perform hardware and software integration.
* Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical and programming issues.
* Conduct controlled indoor and outdoor testing.
* Document engineering designs, test results, component specifications and improvements.

Required Qualifications

Students pursuing or recently completing:

* B.E./B.Tech – Robotics & Automation
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Electrical & Electronics Engineering
* Computer Science / Artificial Intelligence

Students from other disciplines with demonstrated robotics project experience are also welcome.

Essential Skills

Candidates should have practical experience in
**at least two**
of the following areas:

* Mechanical design and CAD modelling
* Robotics hardware assembly and fabrication
* Embedded systems and motor control
* Python, C/C++ or ROS 2
* Sensors, actuators and electronic integration
* Autonomous navigation or computer vision

Preferred Experience

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

* Built a working robotic prototype independently or as part of a team.
* Participated in robotics competitions, hackathons or university robotics clubs.
* Developed quadruped robots, robotic arms, mobile robots, drones or autonomous vehicles.
* Worked with 3D printing, electronics prototyping and hardware debugging.
* Published robotics projects on GitHub or maintained technical project portfolios.

**Previous commercial work experience is not mandatory. Demonstrated practical capability is more important than academic grades alone.**

What We Expect

We are specifically looking for interns who are:

* **Hands-on builders**
  , not just theoretical learners.
* Capable of understanding an engineering requirement and quickly developing a functional prototype.
* Comfortable assembling, programming, testing and troubleshooting hardware.
* Able to work independently while collaborating with mechanical, electronics and AI teams.
* Interested in contributing directly to real product development.
* Disciplined about engineering documentation, safe testing and meeting project milestones.

Selection Process

**Stage 1 – Project Portfolio Review**

Candidates must submit photographs, videos, GitHub repositories or technical descriptions of robotics projects they have personally developed.

**Stage 2 – Technical Interview**

Assessment of mechanical design, electronics, embedded systems, robotics programming and troubleshooting skills.

**Stage 3 – Practical Engineering Assessment**

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small, time-bound robotics design or programming task using accessible tools and equipment.

**Stage 4 – Final Selection**

Selection based on technical capability, practical experience, problem-solving skills and readiness to contribute to active projects.

Internship Benefits

* Work on real-world robotics and autonomous systems.
* Hands-on exposure to mechanical design, electronics, AI and robotic software development.
* Opportunity to contribute to the development of AerX robotic products.
* Technical mentoring and collaborative engineering experience.
* Internship completion certificate based on successful participation.
* Potential consideration for full-time engineering opportunities based on performance and business requirements.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

1. Updated resume.
2. Details of robotics projects completed.
3. Photographs or videos demonstrating working prototypes.
4. GitHub, CAD portfolio or other relevant technical work.
5. Availability and preferred internship duration.

**Email:**
hr@miradortechnologies.ai

**Subject:**
Application – Robotics Design & Development Internship – AerX Space Labs

**AerX Space Labs**

*Design. Build. Program. Innovate.*

**We are looking for students who don't just study robotics — they build robots.**

* You will be encouraged to see the big picture, be innovative, and positively impact millions of customers.
* Successful candidates for this position will have a background in Java or C++. Equally important to these specific skills is a candidate's ability to multi-task, adapt quickly to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, gain new skills, create reliable & maintainable code, and find creative, scalable solutions to difficult problems.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Lead / Senior Consultant to design, deliver, and optimize enterprise-grade D365 and Power Platform solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with solution ownership, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement to drive business outcomes across complex CRM environments.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions aligned with business requirements and best practices.
* Architect and deliver end-to-end solutions across D365 modules including Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service.
* Develop and customize CRM components such as entities, forms, views, dashboards, workflows, plugins, and integrations.
* Build custom solutions using C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Web API.
* Design and implement scalable integrations using Azure and Power Platform capabilities.
* Oversee system architecture, performance tuning, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment to ensure optimal functionality and user experience.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to team members, fostering collaboration and high-quality delivery.
* Engage with business and technical stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear and actionable discussions.
* Participate in project planning, sprint ceremonies, estimations, and delivery governance using Agile methodologies.
* Stay current with Dynamics 365 and Power Platform advancements, recommending continuous improvements.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM configuration, customization, and solution delivery.
* Proficiency in C#, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS with hands-on experience in plugins and workflows.
* Solid knowledge of Power Platform including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
* Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, and business processes.
* Experience designing scalable, maintainable system architectures.
* Proven problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to quality and performance.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in collaborative, Agile teams.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:
  
  

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban).
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted client and stakeholder relationships.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Senior Lead Engineer – React Native (Mobile Applications)**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Lead Engineer with strong experience building and architecting production-grade mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript. The role requires practical experience across both iOS and Android, including native code integration, mobile architecture, performance optimization, and technical leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, and architecture of scalable mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript for both iOS and Android.
* Develop and maintain reusable mobile components, state management, navigation, and application architecture.
* Work with native iOS and Android technologies, including Swift, Kotlin, or Java, to build and integrate native modules, bridges, and platform-specific functionality.
* Drive mobile application performance, stability, security, and maintainability.
* Lead technical decisions, conduct code and architecture reviews, and establish mobile engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable mobile solutions.
* Manage mobile build and release processes, production troubleshooting, and app store deployments.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance across the mobile development team.

**Mandatory Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years of overall software development experience, including 6+ years in mobile application development.
* Strong hands-on experience developing and delivering production applications using React Native and TypeScript.
* Proven experience building and supporting applications on both iOS and Android.
* Practical native development experience with Swift or Objective-C for iOS and Kotlin or Java for Android.
* Experience developing or integrating React Native native modules, bridges, or platform-specific native functionality.
* Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, such as Clean Architecture, MVVM, or modular architecture.
* Experience with state management solutions such as Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or Context API.
* Demonstrated technical leadership in architecture decisions, code reviews, engineering standards, and mentoring.
* Experience delivering and maintaining applications published on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Expo, Expo SDK, EAS Build, or React Native CLI.
* Experience with React Navigation or Expo Router.
* Mobile CI/CD and release automation using Fastlane or EAS.
* Experience with mobile security, authentication, secure storage, deep linking, push notifications, and native SDK integrations.
* Experience with automated testing using Jest, React Native Testing Library, or Detox.
* Experience integrating REST or GraphQL APIs and cloud-based backend services.

title: Software Engineer — Mobile

title: Apprentice - Enterprise Technology Services
description:

* Passion for technology and strong desire to learn

title: Internship Program 2026 - Build Your Career Through Real Project Experience
description:
**Job Description**
Launch Your Career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited
  
  
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
is inviting applications from
**2026 graduates**
and a limited number of
**2025 graduates**
for our
**2027 project expansion plans**
.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, self-motivated individuals who aspire to build a successful career by gaining practical industry experience through real-time software development and business projects.
  
  
**Internship Opportunities Are Available In The Following Departments**

* MERN Stack Development
* Software Testing (Manual & Automation)
* Executive Assistant
* Product Design (UI/UX)
* Human Resources (HR)
* DevOps
* IT Support

This internship is designed for candidates who believe that
**knowledge, practical exposure, discipline, and continuous improvement are the foundation of a successful career.**
Unlike conventional training programs, this is a
**real-time industry learning opportunity**
where interns gain hands-on experience by working alongside experienced professionals on live projects.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
**This Internship Is Ideal For Candidates Who**

* Have graduated in 2026 or are selected from the 2025 graduate batch.
* Are interested in building a career in the ERP and business software domain.
* Are passionate about learning and building a long-term professional career.
* Are willing to learn through practical implementation rather than classroom training.
* Want genuine industry exposure through real-time projects.
* Are self-motivated and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Are willing to accept feedback and continuously improve their performance.
* Are prepared to demonstrate their knowledge and skills through practical work and assessments.
* Value knowledge, discipline, professional growth, and long-term career development.

**This program is not intended for candidates whose primary expectation is immediate stipend or salary.**
Our primary objective is to develop skilled professionals who are capable of building successful long-term careers through continuous learning, practical industry experience, discipline, and proven performance.
  
  
Who Should Not Apply?
  
  
Please carefully understand the nature of this opportunity before applying.
  
  
**Candidates Should Not Apply If They**

* Are not interested in the ERP domain or business software industry.
* Expect an immediate stipend or salary from the beginning of the internship.
* Are primarily looking for a paid internship rather than a performance-based learning opportunity.
* Are looking for an internship only to obtain a certificate.
* Are not willing to undergo strong assessments at every stage.
* Are not comfortable with performance-based continuation.
* Are looking only to complete the internship duration without focusing on learning and performance.
* Are not willing to continuously improve their knowledge and practical skills.
* Are not interested in proving their capabilities through actual work and performance.
* Are not interested in a potential long-term employment opportunity with the organization.
* Are unwilling to take ownership, accept feedback, maintain discipline, and demonstrate professional commitment.

Important
  
  
**This opportunity is not designed for candidates who are looking only for a certificate, immediate payment, or a short-term internship experience.**
**Certification is not guaranteed merely for joining or attending the program.**
This opportunity is for candidates who are genuinely willing to:
  
  
**Learn → Practice → Perform → Improve → Prove Themselves → Build a Career**
If you are genuinely interested in the ERP domain, willing to invest your time and effort in learning, and want to prove yourself through performance with the possibility of securing a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Nature of the Internship
  
  
This internship follows a
**Self-Learning with Industry Mentorship Model.**
**Candidates Will Be Expected To**

* Learn independently with guidance from mentors.
* Complete assigned learning modules and project tasks.
* Work on real client and internal projects.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Continuously improve technical and professional skills.
* Demonstrate discipline, professionalism, and accountability throughout the program.
* Accept feedback positively and implement improvements.
* Demonstrate consistent performance throughout the internship.

Success in this internship depends largely on the candidate's willingness to learn, adapt, take responsibility, and consistently perform.
  
  
Selection Process
  
  
Stage 1 – Five-Day Assessment Program
  
  
Before being admitted into the internship program, every applicant must successfully complete a
**5-working-day assessment**
.
  
  
During this assessment, candidates will be assigned practical tasks to evaluate not only technical aptitude but also professional qualities.
  
  
**The Evaluation Includes**

* Learning ability
* Problem-solving approach
* Discipline and punctuality
* Sincerity and commitment
* Professional ethics
* Ownership and accountability
* Communication skills
* Adaptability
* Consistency in task completion
* Overall suitability for the internship program

Only candidates who successfully complete this assessment will be offered internship positions.
  
  
Internship Structure and Stipend Eligibility
  
  
The internship will be for
**150 working days**
, divided into
**six blocks of 25 working days each**
.
  
  
Block Duration Stipend Blocks 1–3 75 working days
**No stipend**
Block 4 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 5 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 6 25 working days ₹5,000\*
**Total**
**150 working days**
**Up to ₹15,000**
\*
  
  
Stipend eligibility is directly connected to the candidate's performance and successful progression through the internship blocks.
  
  
**Candidates Who Successfully Progress To**
**Block 4 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 5 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 6 → ₹5,000 stipend**
will be eligible for the applicable stipend only after satisfying the required performance standards for the respective block.
  
  
The organization reserves the right to determine stipend eligibility based on the candidate's performance assessment.
  
  
Block-Wise Performance Assessment
  
  
At the end of
**every 25-working-day block**
, candidates will undergo a
**strict performance assessment**
.
  
  
**Each Assessment Will Evaluate**

* Technical learning progress
* Practical implementation skills
* Quality of work
* Discipline and attendance
* Professional behaviour
* Ownership of responsibilities
* Ability to improve based on feedback
* Team collaboration
* Communication
* Problem-solving ability
* Commitment towards career development
* Overall performance

**Candidates who successfully clear the assessment will be allowed to continue to the next block.**
Candidates who do not meet the required standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be allowed to progress to the next block.
  
  
Performance-Based Continuation
  
  
Continuation in the internship is
**entirely based on performance**
.
  
  
**Candidates Who Consistently Demonstrate**

* Learning capability
* Professional conduct
* Improvement mindset
* Discipline
* Accountability
* Positive attitude
* Technical and practical improvement
* Consistency
* Commitment to excellence

will continue through the internship program.
  
  
Candidates who fail to meet the expected standards at any stage may be discontinued from the internship without progressing to the next block.
  
  
**Completion of a particular number of days does not automatically qualify a candidate for the next block. Successful assessment is mandatory for progression.**
Employment Opportunity
  
  
Candidates who successfully complete
**all six internship blocks (150 working days)**
with
**strong, consistent, and proven performance**
will be considered for a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
with the organization.
  
  
**Candidates Who Demonstrate**

* Strong learning capability
* Consistent performance
* Better assessment ratings
* Technical and practical competency
* Professional discipline
* Ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude
* Adaptability
* Ability to contribute effectively to the organization

may offered a
**Fresher role with a starting CTC of ₹1.8 LPA**
, subject to the organization's final assessment, available positions, and business requirements.
  
  
The employment opportunity is intended for candidates who successfully demonstrate strong performance and achieve the required assessment standards throughout the complete internship program.
  
  
Terms & Conditions
  
  
By applying for this internship, candidates acknowledge and agree to the following:
  
  

* Successful completion of the 5-working-day assessment is mandatory before joining the internship.
* The internship consists of six assessment blocks of 25 working days each, totaling 150 working days.
* The first three blocks, totaling 75 working days, are unpaid and no stipend will be provided during this period.
* Candidates must successfully clear the assessment of each block to continue to the subsequent block.
* Candidates who successfully progress to Blocks 4, 5, and 6 may be eligible for a stipend of ₹5,000 per block, subject to satisfactory performance and successful completion of the respective block.
* The maximum stipend payable during the final three blocks is ₹15,000.
* Stipend eligibility is performance-based and is not guaranteed merely by attendance or completion of the block.
* Candidates who fail to meet the required performance standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be permitted to proceed to the next block.
* Candidates are expected to possess strong self-learning capability, discipline, professionalism, accountability, and a positive attitude towards continuous improvement.
* Candidates should remain fully focused on learning, performing, and building their careers throughout the internship.
* Any form of indiscipline, groupism, misconduct, unethical behaviour, misuse of company resources, or activities that negatively impact the learning environment will not be tolerated and may result in immediate discontinuation from the internship.
* Candidates are expected to maintain complete confidentiality regarding company information, projects, clients, intellectual property, and internal processes.
* Performance evaluations conducted by the organization shall be final and binding.
* Completion of the internship does not automatically guarantee employment.
* Candidates who successfully complete all six blocks with strong and consistently demonstrated performance may be considered for a Fresher position with a starting CTC of ₹1.8 LPA, subject to business requirements and available openings.
* Candidates who voluntarily discontinue the internship or whose internship is terminated due to unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, or violation of company policies will not be eligible to receive an Internship Completion Certificate or Experience Certificate for the period served.
* Candidates seeking only a certificate, immediate stipend, or immediate salary should not apply for this program.
* Certification is not guaranteed merely based on joining or attending the internship.
* All decisions made by the organization regarding assessment results, continuation, discontinuation, stipend eligibility, certification, and employment shall be final.

Ready to Build Your Career?
  
  
**If You Are**

* Self-motivated
* Disciplined
* Passionate about learning
* Interested in the ERP domain
* Willing to work hard
* Willing to learn through practical experience
* Ready to undergo strict performance assessments
* Looking for genuine industry exposure
* Committed to building a long-term career
* Interested in proving yourself through performance

we encourage you to apply and begin your professional journey with
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
.
  
  
**Learn. Perform. Improve. Prove Yourself. Build Your Career.**
**Apply Now and Shape Your Future with Us.**
Important Information
  
  
Limited Vacancies
  
  
**Please Note:**
Internship positions are limited. Applications will be processed on a
**first-come, first-preference basis**
, subject to eligibility and successful completion of the selection process.
  
  
We encourage interested candidates to apply as early as possible.
  
  
Assessment & Internship Details
  
  
**Location:**
Office-Based
**(On-Premises only)**
**Office Address:**
Chromepet, Chennai
  
  
**Working Days:**
Monday to Friday
  
  
**Office Hours:**
9:30 AM – 7:30 PM
  
  
**Attendance:**
Continuous participation throughout both the Assessment and Internship is mandatory.
  
  
This internship is a full-time, office-based learning program. Candidates should ensure they can commit to the complete schedule before applying.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
If You Are Genuinely Interested In This Opportunity, Please Submit Your Application Along With Your Updated Resume And Provide Detailed Responses To The Following Questions
  
  
1️⃣ Why do you believe you are a suitable candidate for this internship?
  
  
Please explain your strengths, learning mindset, career aspirations, interest in the ERP domain, and why you feel you are the right fit for the selected role.
  
  
2️⃣ Confirmation of Interest
  
  
Kindly confirm that you have carefully read the
**Internship Program details, Stipend Structure, Terms & Conditions, and Performance Assessment Process**
, and that you are interested in participating in the
**5-Day Assessment Program**
followed by the internship, if selected.
  
  
3️⃣ Availability Confirmation
  
  
Please confirm that you are able to attend both the Assessment Program and the Internship continuously as per the organization's office location, working days, and office timings.
  
  
Important Notice
  
  
You may have come across this internship opportunity through various sources, including job portals, social media, WhatsApp groups, referrals, or other online platforms.
  
  
Regardless of where you learned about this opportunity,
**we strongly recommend that every applicant visit our official website, carefully read the complete Internship Program details, Terms & Conditions, Stipend Structure, and Assessment Process, and submit the application only through the official application process.**
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited does not charge any registration fee, training fee, security deposit, placement fee, or any other payment for this Internship Program.**
If anyone claims to represent the company and requests money or any form of payment in exchange for internship selection or employment, please treat it as fraudulent. We request all applicants to remain vigilant and avoid such scams.
  
  
Application Process
  
  
Due to the large number of applications we receive, we request all candidates to:
  
  

* Submit their application through our official website.

As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. **Job Summary**
This job entails writing and maintaining clean, efficient code for various software components while following development best practices. It supports the design and innovation of new applications that align with business goals. * Supporting the design and development of new software applications aligned with business objectives
* Implementing testing frameworks for software validation, including unit and integration tests, to ensure quality
* Documenting the software development process, including design and deployment procedures, to facilitate knowledge sharing
* Analyzing software integration needs and planning system architecture to meet technical specifications
* Reviewing current practices and technical literature to inform project solutions and applying engineering methodologies
* Working with Quality Assurance to ensure applications meet technical requirements and fit specifications
* Troubleshooting software issues, providing resolutions to enhance application performance and user satisfaction
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Must Have Skills**

* Performance & scalability design,
* Strong SQL/PLSQL, query writing, and hands-on with Oracle/SQL Server/MySQL

* Design patterns (Repository, Service, existing codebase patterns)

* REST API design,
* Angular + TypeScript, Jest, ReactJS, Redux

* Oracle DB schema design & optimization,
* Authentication/Authorization architecture (Spring Security, OAuth2/SSO),
* Integration patterns (REST, WebSocket/STOMP, SFTP, scheduled jobs),

**Good To Have Skills**

* Spec-driven architecture
* Building custom AI agents / RAG pipelines
* Monitoring & observability (Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus)
* Security scanning (Snyk)

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.

* Experience with Copilot Studio and Power Platform
* MCP, Skills knowledge

* We act with intensity, urgency and a passion for supporting our customers and growing our business. We strive for excellence.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Who We Are
  
  
At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves. Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.
  
  
Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.
  
  
**About The Role**
Platform Science is looking for a
**Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)**
to join our Core Product Development team in Chennai. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust manual and automated test suites across our web and mobile applications, ensuring our edge-to-cloud IoT solutions meet strict performance, stability, and quality standards.
  
  
You will play an integral role across the complete software development lifecycle—designing automated UI and API tests, driving exploratory test sessions, and identifying system malfunctions early. Additionally, you will coordinate seamlessly across time zones, collaborating closely with our distributed teams and stakeholders in both India and the US.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities (Measures Of Success)**

* Full-Lifecycle Quality Assurance: Participate actively across all stages of product development, including new feature releases, platform upgrades, functional enhancements, performance testing, and defect resolution.
* Test Automation & Execution: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated UI and API test frameworks for web applications and mobile platforms (iOS and Android).
* Exploratory & Manual Testing: Execute rigorous exploratory tests on new features and bug fixes, blending manual validation with automated test suites.
* Defect Lifecycle Management: Identify, document, isolate, and track software defects in Jira with thorough root-cause investigations, logs, and clear reproduction steps.
* Cross-Timezone Collaboration: Proactively communicate project status, risks, and technical blockers; balance working hours between Indian and US time zones to attend client/sync calls and address critical production issues.
* Continuous Improvement: Research, evaluate, and adopt industry best practices in Quality Engineering, test automation, and Continuous Integration (CI).

**Target Capabilities & Skills**

* Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience as a Software QA Engineer or SDET.
* Core Programming: Strong coding proficiency in Java; knowledge or experience with Kotlin or JavaScript is a significant advantage.
* Mobile Test Automation: Proven hands-on experience authoring automated test scripts for native and hybrid mobile applications (iOS and Android) using Appium, Selenium, or WebdriverIO.
* Compatibility Testing: Deep understanding of backward compatibility testing across varying operating system versions and device configurations.
* Test Design Methodologies: Strong applied knowledge of test design techniques, including Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Tables, and Use Case testing.
* Agile QA Practices: Practical experience working with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and exploratory testing patterns.

**Other Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (equivalent practical QA engineering experience will be considered in place of a degree).
* Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills to interact productively with engineering teams, leadership, and global stakeholders.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex architectural documents, technical specs, diagrams, and data models.
* Mindset & Ownership: Demonstrates intellectual humility (learning actively from mistakes), self-motivation, high ownership, and the ability to operate effectively with minimal supervision.

**Benefits**
The company offers various benefits to regular, full-time employees including:
  
  

* Provident fund and gratuity in accordance with applicable laws.
* Paid vacation, sick leave and holidays, in accordance with applicable laws.
* Twenty-Six weeks of paid maternity leave in accordance with applicable laws.

*(Note: The compensation details listed in India role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.)*

Defects and process non\-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. -

 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.


**Recruitment Assessments**
 Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.
